# anecdotes_analysis_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a single Anecdotes Analysis Rule by ID, whether it is one the account authored
or one shipped with the platform.

Archived (deleted) rules are not returned. Use the `anecdotes_analysis_rules`
data source with `include_archived` to read those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single rule by ID. Supplying evidence_id is optional and only makes
# the lookup cheaper, by avoiding a read of the platform's full rule library.
data "anecdotes_analysis_rule" "example" {
  rule_id = "analysis_rule_1234567890123"
}

output "rule_query" {
  value = data.anecdotes_analysis_rule.example.rule_query_str
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (String) The unique identifier of the analysis rule to look up.

### Optional

- `evidence_id` (String) The evidence the rule is attached to. Optional, and only a hint: supplying it makes the lookup cheaper.

### Read-Only

- `account_scoping_list` (Set of String) Service instance IDs the rule is scoped to. Unordered.
- `account_scoping_type` (String) Which accounts the rule applies to.
- `alert_level` (Number) Severity: 30 (warning) or 50 (gap). 3, 5 and 10 describe an evaluation outcome rather than a configured severity.
- `last_updated` (String) When the rule was last modified.
- `last_updated_by` (String) Who last modified the rule.
- `library_rule_id` (String) The library rule this rule was derived from.
- `rule_is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the rule has been deleted. Deleting archives a rule rather than removing it.
- `rule_message` (String) The message shown for rows the rule matches.
- `rule_name` (String) The rule's display name.
- `rule_origin` (String) Whether the rule ships with the platform ("library") or is authored by the account ("custom").
- `rule_query_message` (String) Message associated with the stored query.
- `rule_query_str` (String) The query as the platform stored it, serialized as a JSON string.
- `rule_query_type` (String) The query language: "aql", "aqlext" or "pandas".
- `rule_state` (String) Whether the rule is evaluated: "active" or "inactive".
- `rule_type` (String) Processing type: "uam" or "eid".
